method.frontal: The mid-side canceller assumes a centered desired source. The existing fixed-clock WPE transform supplies the STFT. Regress complex mid on side within each frequency bin over the full six-second upload, using 10% of median side spectral energy as a floor and capping complex gain magnitude at two. Keep frequencies below 150 Hz unchanged. Subtract 0.7 of the fitted component before overlap-add. Reject clipped views and outputs under 2% of original mono energy.
method.rendering: Development uses Surrey and IS1001b, assessment uses BBC and ES2012b. Front foreground, alternating left/right competing source. The complete speech is centered in a fixed three-second interval of a six-second stereo mixture. The same annotated competing speech, absolute gain and native rendering apply to all three origins of each prompt. Normalize the target room mean energy of each origin to a common level. Render room-only, 0 and -5 dB mixture, and matched background-only controls. Scale all views together before signed integer addition.
method.scores: Use the existing voice model and speech admission on the fixed three-second range for native mono, blind WPE, and a frontal mid-side canceller. Fit one threshold per arm using admitted noisy human responses only. Each primary point is the maximum over four development speakers, and the sensitivity point allows one development speaker. Compare all noisy held true and false results by origin and speaker, plus matched background-only, availability and acoustic SNR. Room-only mono is diagnostic.
method.sources: Freeze two exact ODSS triplets per publisher speaker. The complete native words fit the same three-second interval; no splices, crops, speed changes or newly generated speech. Match both generators and human by ZIP member suffix and pinned publisher transcript. Deterministically split four speakers into development and four into assessment. Exclude any shared normalized prompt across the whole panel.
